component.name: Codex LB Status
component.summary: Read-only Codex LB quota and account monitor

description.p: Monitor Codex LB account-pool quota and status from an Ubuntu desktop tray indicator.
The application is read-only and does not change accounts, routing policies, quota settings, or server administration.
Prepared the codebase for public development and hardened local session isolation.
Normalized desktop metadata and added a sanitized Ubuntu screenshot.
Refined Details labels and aligned pooled account values.
Prepared the project for public development and hardened local session isolation.
Matched pooled quota increase countdowns to account reset labels.
Added nearest quota-increase times to the pooled averages.
Preserved native message-dialog header space after Qt relayout.
Kept native message-dialog titles fully visible.
Scoped modal stacking to the Details window instead of all applications.
Closed all open dialogs whenever the Details window closes.
Kept modal dialogs above Details without disabling their controls.
Made the Details window fill the available screen height.
Adjusted Details window height for larger account pools.
Flattened quota summaries and tightened the Details window layout.
Highlighted quota limits and aligned secondary windows with Details.
Split collapsed account rows into clear identity/status and quota/reset lines.
Corrected spacing between the Actions label and its menu indicator.
Added stale-data warnings, an Actions menu, improved sign-in layouts, and collapsed reset summaries.
Simplified tray activation to a native double-click with no menu or registration workaround.
Corrected single-click Details activation on Ubuntu GNOME without exposing a popup command.
Made the Ubuntu activation bridge invisible and added click-to-toggle Details.
Restored single-click Details activation on Ubuntu AppIndicator hosts.
Replaced the tray menu with native hover status and click-to-pin details.
Added a dynamically fitted dual-quota tray label and simplified quota summaries.
Added a scalable fixed-size pool summary and a persistent in-menu refresh action.
Improved tray account navigation, refresh feedback, reset-credit visibility, dashboard access, and shutdown labeling.
Corrected tray-owned window lifecycle state so intentionally closed details stay closed while active minimized windows can still be restored.
Aligned account status and weighted quota semantics with Codex LB, completed API contract validation, and hardened authentication and background errors.
Corrected connected-account quota averages, account health indicators, window restoration, and right-side dialog placement.
Improved tray readability, signed-out privacy, account status indicators, and tray-attached windows.
Fixed repeated tray activation, added local sign-out, and reduced decorative action icons.
Added compact expandable account summaries and simplified tray actions.
Standardized all status indicators on round icons.
Removed the footer background from the status window.
Redesigned the native status, tray, settings, and authentication interfaces.
